subject: phy
title: Physical Quantities and Units
subtitle: Physical Quantities and Units with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Physics depends on reliable measurement. Any measured value has uncertainty, and understanding this uncertainty is essential for evaluating experiment quality and conclusions.
Dimensional analysis and unit consistency allow quick checking of equation validity and numerical plausibility.
In Cambridge AS practical work, strong answers combine correct numerical processing with clear treatment of random and systematic errors.
